title: Delivery completion based on carrier scan only
operational_setting: A carrier marks a shipment delivered when its own device records a delivery scan, while recipient acceptance is not independently captured.
trust_boundary: Carrier evidence is used by parties with potentially conflicting incentives.
intended_transition: Shipment accepted as delivered to the intended recipient/location.

attack.procedure: Use the carrier's self-issued scan as the only evidence and test whether the claimed transition can be robustly distinguished from action completion or false delivery.

success_criteria_for_attack: If self-issued evidence is enough under the actual trust model, broader independent-evidence claims weaken; otherwise Evidence/Verification survive.
